test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following bar diagram shows the number of students who opted for the different subjects in the year 2020 and 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c099dbaea2b10d6e71c06e38f0c7974e91b3b3ff46d6ab1aab8e0451c5cd21fd.png] 

Find the ratio of students opting Economics to students opting Physical Education in 2020.
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/827a5e089bad8ea8371c432f7d452e81109715c42005df55806d33d288c79553.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Number of students opted Economics in 2020 = 75

⇒ Number of students opted Physical Education in 2020 = 125

⇒ Ratio of students opted Economics and Physical Education = (75)/(125) = 3 : 5

**Therefore, the ratio of number of students opted Economics to Physical Education in 2020 is 3 : 5.**
